title: Turntable Shipyard
summary: A tactics-style canal boatyard diorama floating in darkness, turned like a model on a lazy susan: A dawn with bare ribs on the keel, B night with the finished ship a quarter-turn later.
request: a tactics-style canal boatyard diorama floating in darkness, built once in tools/iso.py and tools/sdf.py and turned like a model on a lazy susan: four quarter-turns, each advancing time and construction (bare ribs at dawn, planked hull at noon, deck and rails at dusk, mast and pennants at night with lanterns lit). Two stills of the best moments and a 5 s work-song sample.

outputs.name: sample
outputs.run: python3 sound/shanty.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i sound/07-sample.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 sound/07-sample.mp3

anatomy.draws: The scene brief: intent, tactics style, 2:1 iso layout, value plan, sound plan
anatomy.change_for: intent, mood and the written rules the gate reads

anatomy.draws: Gate lines (hero box and value plan) for image B only
anatomy.change_for: the B hero or value plan when B changes

anatomy.draws: One 3D description of the boatyard in model coordinates (slab, dock, hull field, crane, sawpit, lock gates, canal, hut), turned in quarter-turns and rasterised through tools/iso.py and tools/sdf.py; run with a, b or export
anatomy.change_for: the model, the turn and stage, time of day

anatomy.draws: Greyscale block-in from the real 3D description
Synthesises 'Caulkers' Dawn', a 6/8 D mixolydian work song with concertina, bass, mallets and saw, as a 5.0 s sample
